domain.description: The host name of the Regie, if one is set.

acmeEmail.description: E-mail of the Let's Encrypt account (dns-* modes).

dnsChallengeDomain.description: Delegation target of `_acme-challenge`, if one is set.

credentialFields.description: Which credential fields are stored (names only).

AddSceneItemRequest.description: Request to add a source to a scene. Missing values are chosen by the server (on a 1920 × 1080 canvas 1240/680, 600 × 338, radius 12, contain for screens; other canvases get the same layout in proportion).

AllocateSlotRequest.description: Allocates a new slot on the device (another screen, or the optional laptop camera).

ApplyStatusDto.description: Whether the services run the saved settings.

applied.description: True when the service runs the saved settings.

error.description: Why not, if the last attempt failed (English, no secrets).

id.description: Asset id, e.g. `ast_…`; also the source reference.

name.description: Display name (from the file name, editable).

contentUrl.description: Relative URL of the content. The output appends its key as `?k=`.

AssetKind.description: Kind of an uploaded media asset.

sourceId.description: The source: a device slot, an image or a video. A text cannot take the place of a camera.

AssignPlaceholderRequest.description: Assigns a placeholder to a source: every scene item that shows the placeholder shows the source from now on.

AuditCategory.description: What an entry of the audit log is about: the category filter of the log view and a column of the export.

id.description: Database id; ascending in the order the entries were written.

productionId.description: Production of the action; null for global actions such as sign-ins.

productionName.description: Current name of the production, or null.

oneOf.description: Log code for the text of the entry, or null for an action this version does not describe (then Text is the action code).

params.description: Values for the text of the code, keyed in camelCase; the same values as the params of a log entry.

text.description: English text for clients that do not know the code.

details.description: All details of the entry (device name, scene, IP address of a sign-in); never secrets.

AuditEntryDto.description: An entry of the audit log as the Regie shows it.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last page.

AuditPageDto.description: One page of the audit log, newest first.

name.description: Folder name, e.g. `2026-10-26_0300_auto`; the argument of `restore`.

serviceSeen.description: False when the backup service has not reported yet (not started, or the status file is missing).

running.description: True while a backup runs or waits for the end of a broadcast.

postponed.description: True while a run waits for the end of a broadcast.

lastError.description: Why the last run failed, if it did.

BackupsDto.description: The latest backups and the state of the backup service.

schedule.description: Cron expression; null: automatic backups are off.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the schedule; null: UTC.

rcloneRemote.description: The rclone remote of the off-site copy; null: none.

rcloneConfigured.description: True when an rclone.conf is stored (it is never returned).

ageRecipients.description: Public age keys that encrypt the off-site copy.

offsiteUnencrypted.description: The remote encrypts by itself, so the copy is not encrypted here.

BackupSettingsDto.description: The backup schedule and the off-site target.

serverMs.description: Time the server needed to receive the body.

BandwidthTestResultDto.description: Result of the upload part of the technical check.

BorderDto.description: Border drawn inside the item rectangle.

BroadcastState.description: Broadcast state of a production. Standby and Ended show a slate on the output.

lenses.description: The device's cameras; empty when the browser lists none.

focusModes.description: Supported focus modes; empty without focus control.

CameraCapabilitiesDto.description:
What the camera in use can do (from `MediaStreamTrack.getCapabilities()`). A control the camera does not
support is missing here and the Regie does not show it.

lensId.description: Switch to this lens (an id from the reported lenses); the picture freezes briefly.

reset.description: Back to automatic: zoom out, automatic focus, no brightness shift, light off. The lens stays.

CameraControlDto.description:
Remote camera control (partial update, command kind DeviceCommandKind.CameraControl). The device
resets first when Reset is set, then applies every other field that is set.

id.description: Browser device id; stable while the browser is.

label.description: Name from the browser, if it gives one.

CameraLensKind.description: What a lens is, derived by the sender from the name the browser gives the camera.

CameraRangeDto.description: Range of a numeric camera setting.

lensId.description: Device id of the lens in use.

CameraSettingsDto.description: The settings the camera really has right now (from `getSettings()`); null where the camera reports none.

problem.description: The last command the camera refused (`overconstrained`, `failed`); null once a command works again.

CameraStateDto.description: Camera section of a device report (and of the telemetry the Regie gets).

width.description: Width in canvas pixels, derived from format and resolution.

height.description: Height in canvas pixels, derived from format and resolution.

CanvasDto.description:
The output canvas of a production: the coordinate system of all scene items and the shape of the output page, the
monitors and the thumbnails. One canvas per production.

CanvasFormat.description: Format (aspect ratio) of the output canvas. One format per production; the list is fixed so the layouts fit.

CanvasResolution.description: Target resolution of the output canvas, named after the short side. Together with the format it gives the canvas size.

CertificateInfoDto.description: An uploaded certificate as the Regie shows it (never the key).

ChangeCanvasRequest.description:
Sets format and resolution of the output canvas. The same format with another resolution scales every scene item
proportionally; another format fits the items into the new canvas (scaled uniformly, centred) and lets the Auto-Grid
arrange itself for the new shape. Not possible while the broadcast is live (409 `broadcast_live`).

ChangePasswordRequest.description: Changes the password of the signed-in admin; every other session ends.

cloneFromSceneId.description: Copy items, layout mode and background from this scene.

oneOf.description: Alignment; the style's default when missing.

CreateTextSourceRequest.description: Request to create a text source.

CropDto.description: Crop per side as a fraction (0–0.45) of the source picture. Opposite sides sum to less than 0.9.

slot.description: Target slot for reshare and camera control.

at.description: Time the server created the command.

oneOf.description: Payload of DeviceCommandKind.CameraControl, already clamped to what the device reported.

DeviceCommandKind.description: Remote command the Regie sends to a device.

DeviceCommandRequest.description: Sends a remote command to a device.

DeviceConnection.description: Live connection state of a device as seen by the server.

DeviceCredentialsDto.description: Credentials of a paired device. The secret is shown exactly to the device and stored only as a hash.

id.description: Device id, e.g. `dev_…`; equals the LiveKit participant identity.

name.description: Display name, editable in the Regie.

platform.description: Short platform text reported by the sender, e.g. “iPhone · Safari”.

connectionSince.description: Time of the last connection change.

DeviceDto.description: A paired device (station) as shown in the Regie.

sessionId.description: Random id of this browser tab; a newer session replaces an older one.

DeviceHelloDto.description: First message of a device after connecting to the device hub.

rttMs.description: Round trip time measured by the sender.

oneOf.description: Result of the last technical check, if any.
Capabilities and settings of the phone camera; null without a camera or on a laptop.

DeviceReportDto.description: Periodic report of a device (about every two seconds).

DeviceSelfDto.description: What a device learns about itself (sender app).

DeviceSlotDto.description: A slot that belongs to a device, with its slot code.

batteryPct.description: Battery level 0–100 where the browser exposes it.

network.description: Network type, e.g. “wifi” or “4g”, where available.

rttMs.description: Round trip time to the server.

oneOf.description: What the phone camera can do and does now; null where it reports nothing.

DeviceTelemetryDto.description: Telemetry of a device, reported about every two seconds.

DeviceTelemetryMessage.description: Telemetry push to the Regie; not revisioned.

fields.description: Names of the credential fields (all secret, none is ever returned).

DnsProviderDto.description: A DNS provider and the credential fields it needs.

name.description: Name of the copy; “{name} (copy)” when missing. A name that is taken gets “ (2)”, “ (3)” … appended.

origins.description: The origins; `'self'` is always allowed and not listed.

EmbeddingSettingsDto.description: The origins that may embed the output.

label.description: Name of the source, or null.

ImportPlaceholderDto.description: A device source of the imported production, which becomes a placeholder.

name.description: Name the production would get (with “ (2)” appended when the name is taken).

appVersion.description: Version of StudioFlow that wrote the file.

texts.description: Number of texts and lower thirds.

media.description: Number of media files (images and videos).

mediaBytes.description: Size of the media files together.

placeholders.description: The device sources that become placeholders.

warnings.description: What the operator should know before importing.

ImportPreviewDto.description: What an import would do; the answer of `POST /api/productions/import?dryRun=true`. Nothing is stored.

params.description: Values for the text of the code, keyed in camelCase.

ImportWarningDto.description: A warning of the import preview. Clients show their own text for the code.

endedAt.description: Recovery time; null while the outage lasts.

IncidentDto.description: An incident in the message strip. Recovered incidents stay until someone acknowledges them (“Seen”).

IncidentKind.description: Kind of an incident in the message strip.

url.description: Absolute URL with the secret token; only visible to the Regie.

InviteDto.description: A one-time invite (QR code for phones, link for laptops). Valid once for 30 minutes.

ItemFit.description: How a source is fitted into its item rectangle.

url.description: WebSocket URL of LiveKit (same origin, proxied by Caddy).

expiresAt.description: Token expiry; LiveKit refreshes it for running connections.

LiveKitTokenDto.description: LiveKit connection data for a client. The token carries exactly the rights of the role.

LogCode.description:
What an entry of "Recent events" reports. Clients show their own text for the code and fill in the params of the
entry; the English text of the entry is the fallback for clients that do not know the code yet.

code.description: What happened. Clients show their own text for the code, in the language of the user.

params.description: Values for the text of the code (scene, device or slot names), keyed in camelCase; the keys per code are listed at the codes.

text.description: English text for clients that do not know the code; the same words as the English client text.

LogEntryDto.description: An entry of "Recent events", derived from the audit log.

holdMs.description: How long the last frame stays sharp (0…600000 ms); null keeps it forever. Afterwards the frame is blurred and darkened with “Picture returns shortly”, or the fallback source is shown.

fallbackSource.description: Optional replacement source reference (e.g. a pause slate image).

LostBehaviorDto.description: Fallback when the source of an item fails.

address.description: The IPv4 address LiveKit announces; null until the wizard saved it.

fromHost.description: The IPv4 address the admin opened the page with (the `Host` header), if it is one.

interfaces.description: IPv4 addresses of the interfaces the API sees (inside Docker these are not the addresses of the host).

MediaSuggestionsDto.description: Where the media address could come from.

expiresAt.description: When the trial configuration of LiveKit ends if nobody saves the address.

MediaTestDto.description:
What the browser needs for the round trip: two participants of a throw-away room. LiveKit announces the tested address
for the test (it was restarted with it); the browser connects over the same origin as the page and sends a message from
one participant to the other and back.

address.description: The IPv4 address to announce for the test.

MediaTestRequest.description: Asks for a test of a media address.

events.description: Events after the requested revision, oldest first; null when a snapshot is returned.

oneOf.description: Full output state; null when IReadOnlyList<ProductionEvent>? OutputChangesDto.Events is returned.

OutputChangesDto.description:
Output variant of ProductionChangesDto (hub `SubscribeOutput` and `GET /api/output/{slug}/changes`):
changes the output must not see – devices, pairing, invites, incidents, log, output status and health-only source
changes – appear as RevisionOnlyEvent with the same revision.

url.description: Absolute output URL including the secret key of the link.

keyCreatedAt.description: When the current key was created.

lastSeenAt.description: When a page of the link last connected or disconnected; null while it was never used.

allowedIps.description: IP addresses or CIDR ranges allowed to open the link; empty allows every address.

OutputLinkDto.description: An output link for the Regie.

consumers.description: Number of connected output pages of the link.

addresses.description: Remote IP addresses of the output pages of the link.

latencyMs.description: Estimated receive latency reported by the output page.

fps.description: Rendered frames per second of the program.

OutputLinkStatusDto.description: Live state of one output link (a consumer such as the proxy or the Teams camera).

rendering.description: The page renders the program (false while connecting).

latencyMs.description: Estimated receive latency (RTT/2 plus jitter buffer delay).

OutputReport.description: Status report of an output page, sent about every two seconds.

maxLinks.description: Maximum number of links per production.

frameAncestors.description: Domains allowed to embed the output (from configuration, read-only).

revision.description: Same revision counter as the Regie snapshot.

scenes.description: All scenes (the output preloads their sources).

OutputSnapshot.description: Production state for the output page. Contains no device, pairing or incident data.

OutputState.description: Connection state of the output consumer (proxy).

state.description: Connected when any link is connected, else stale when any link is stale, else none.

consumers.description: Number of connected output pages of all links.

addresses.description: Remote IP addresses of the output pages of all links.

latencyMs.description: Estimated receive latency reported by the output page that reported last.

fps.description: Rendered frames per second of the program, from the same report.

lastReportAt.description: Last report time of any link.

links.description: Every output link of the production, ordered by name.

OutputStatusDto.description: Live state of the output (chip “Output” in the header): the summary over all links, and every link on its own.

PairingRequestCreatedDto.description: Answer to a knock: the requester keeps the poll token secret and polls with it.

name.description: Device name typed on the laptop.

checkCode.description: Four digit check code, shown as “47 12” on both screens.

PairingRequestDto.description: A pending /join request as shown to the Regie (knock card).

PairingRequestStatus.description: Status of an anonymous pairing request from /join.

PairingRequestStatusDto.description: Poll result for a knock. Credentials are present once the Regie approved.

items.description: Scene items that show the source now (assigned) or were removed (removed).

PlaceholderChangeDto.description: What assigning or removing a placeholder changed.

events.description: Events after the requested revision, oldest first; null when a snapshot is returned.

oneOf.description: Full state; null when IReadOnlyList<ProductionEvent>? ProductionChangesDto.Events is returned.

ProductionChangesDto.description:
Answer to a (re)subscribe or `GET …/changes?since=`: either the missed events (delta) or a full snapshot when the
server no longer holds all events since the requested revision.

tenantId.description: Tenant id; only `opten` for now (multi-tenancy is prepared, not active).

name.description: Display name shown in the header.

slug.description: URL slug of the output page (`/o/{slug}`).

isActive.description: The active production is the one /join pairs into.

liveSince.description: Start of the current broadcast (LIVE runtime in the header).

programSceneId.description: Scene on air. Null only when the production has no scenes.

previewSceneId.description: Scene in the preview (Studio-Modus). Null when no operator uses Studio-Modus.

oneOf.description: Transition of the last program switch.

lastSwitchAt.description: Server time of the last program switch.

textTheme.description: Colours of all texts and lower thirds.

canvas.description: Format and resolution of the output canvas; every scene item is placed in its pixels.

ProductionDto.description: Production (OBS: scene collection): one event with its own devices, scenes and output.

ProductionEvent.description:
A revisioned change of the production state, pushed over SignalR (method string HubMethods.Event).
Clients apply an event only when its revision is exactly one above their own; a larger gap triggers a resync
(new snapshot), a smaller revision is ignored.

ProductionEventAssetUpsertedEvent.description: An asset was uploaded or renamed.

ProductionEventDeviceUpsertedEvent.description: A device was paired or changed (name, state, connection, tech check).

ProductionEventIncidentRemovedEvent.description: An incident was acknowledged or superseded.

ProductionEventIncidentUpsertedEvent.description: An incident started, changed or recovered.

ProductionEventInviteRemovedEvent.description: An invite was used, revoked or expired.

ProductionEventPairingRequestRemovedEven.description: A knock was approved, denied or expired.

ProductionEventPlaceholderRemovedEvent.description: A placeholder was assigned to a source or removed. The scenes that changed arrive as `sceneUpserted` before it.

production.description: The production with its new canvas.

scenes.description: The scenes whose items were rescaled (scenes without items are unchanged and not listed).

ProductionEventProductionCanvasChangedEv.description:
The output canvas changed. Production and the rescaled scenes arrive in one revision, so no client ever shows the new
canvas with the geometry of the old one.

ProductionEventProductionChangedEvent.description: Production settings or broadcast state changed (not a program switch).

previousProgramSceneId.description: Program scene before the switch (fade source).

transition.description: Transition to play; a cut when only the preview changed.

ProductionEventProgramSwitchedEvent.description: Program and/or preview changed. Renderers play TransitionDto ProgramSwitchedEvent.Transition when the program changed.

ProductionEventRevisionOnlyEvent.description: Placeholder that only advances the revision; sent to clients that must not see the actual change (output page).

ProductionEventScenesReorderedEvent.description: The scene order changed; IReadOnlyList<string> ScenesReorderedEvent.SceneIds lists every scene in the new order.

ProductionEventSceneUpsertedEvent.description: A scene was created or changed.

ProductionEventSourceRemovedEvent.description: A source was removed (slot released, device or asset deleted).

ProductionEventSourceUpsertedEvent.description: A source was created or its health or label changed.

revision.description: Monotonic revision; every ProductionEvent carries the next one.

serverTime.description: Server clock, used to correct client timers.

placeholders.description: Device sources of the production this one was copied from, not assigned yet.

incidents.description: Open and recovered, not yet acknowledged incidents.

ProductionSnapshot.description: Complete production state for the Regie. Sent on subscribe and after a resync.

clientId.description: Random id the browser generated before redeeming; repeating the call with the same id within five minutes returns the same device (lost responses).

name.description: Optional device name; defaults to a generated one.

RedeemInviteRequest.description: Redeems a QR code or invite link.

itemIds.description: Every item id of the scene exactly once; a list that does not match the current items is a 409 `conflict`.

ReorderSceneItemsRequest.description: New z-order of a scene: the ids of all its items, back to front. Only the order changes, never an item.

ReorderScenesRequest.description: New order of all scenes; must contain every scene id exactly once.

items.description: Complete new item list, back to front.

oneOf.description: Optional new layout mode (the Auto-Grid template sets SceneLayoutMode.AutoGrid).

ReplaceSceneItemsRequest.description: Replaces all items of a scene (templates, undo/redo, reordering).

RtcState.description: Media connection state reported by the sender.

assetId.description: Optional image asset, drawn with cover fit.

SceneBackgroundDto.description: Canvas background: a colour and an optional image asset on top of it.

sortOrder.description: Position in the scene list, 0-based (keys 1–9 select the first nine).

version.description: Increments with every change of this scene.

SceneDto.description: Scene: ordered items on the canvas of the production (its `canvas` field). Item order is the z-order (first = back).

id.description: Item id, e.g. `itm_…`; unique within the scene.

source.description: Source reference: `{deviceId}/{slot}` for device slots, `{assetId}` for media.

crop.description: Crop per side as a fraction of the source picture.

locked.description: Locked items cannot be moved in the editor.

SceneItemDto.description: Element of a scene (OBS: scene item). Geometry is in canvas pixels.

configured.description: True once the media address was saved; before that the wizard continues after the account step.

dnsProviders.description: The DNS providers this version supports.

ServerSettingsDto.description: Everything the wizard and the "Server settings" page show.

SetPreviewRequest.description: Sets or clears the preview scene.

setupCode.description: The one-time code from the server log (`XXXX-XXXX`).

username.description: User name of the new account.

SetupRequest.description: First-run setup: creates the Regie account and signs it in.

setupRequired.description: True while the first-run setup is open.

SetupStatusDto.description: Whether the Regie has no account yet. Public, because the Regie asks before anyone is signed in.

backgroundAssetId.description: Optional image asset behind the text.

SlateDto.description: A full-screen slate on the output.

SlotState.description: State of a slot on a device as reported by the sender.

SlotTelemetryDto.description: Telemetry of one slot (camera or screen) of a device.

code.description: Slot code shown everywhere: K1… cameras, S1… screens, M1… media.

kind.description: Camera, screen, image, video or text.

label.description: Display name, e.g. “Laptop Lea · Screen 1”; the first line of a text.

slot.description: Slot name for device slots: `camera` or `screen-1`…`screen-9`. Equals the LiveKit track name.

statusSince.description: Time of the last status change (timers in the Regie).

oneOf.description: Content of a text source; null for every other kind.

SourceDto.description: A source that scene items can show.

sourceId.description: The source reference scene items use: `{deviceId}/{slot}` of a device that does not exist.

code.description: Slot code of the original source: K1… for cameras, S1… for screens.

label.description: Name of the original source (“Stage phone”), or null when the copy did not know it.

SourcePlaceholderDto.description:
A device source of the production this one was copied from (duplicate or import). Devices belong to one production
and are paired anew, so the copy keeps the place of the source as a placeholder: scene items point to
SourceId, which no device has, so they show “Source missing” until the placeholder is assigned to a
source (`PUT …/placeholders/{id}/assignment`), typically the new device that takes over the role, “Use as K1 ·
Stage phone”. A placeholder keeps its code, so no new source takes it.

SourceStatus.description: Health of a source as shown in the Regie (lamps, washes, message strip).

SwitchProgramRequest.description: Request for a direct program switch (Studio-Modus off).

TakeRequest.description: Request for a take (Studio-Modus): the preview goes on air and the old program moves to the preview.

TallyDto.description: Tally of a device: overall and per slot.

TallyState.description: Tally of a source or device.

TechCheckDto.description: Result of the technical check on the sender (camera, network, bandwidth).

TechCheckLevel.description: Traffic light used by the technical check.

TextAlign.description: Horizontal alignment of a text source (the lower third always follows the reading direction).

line1.description: Main line (a name or a title), 1–120 characters.

line2.description: Optional second line (a role), at most 120 characters.

align.description: Horizontal alignment; the lower third ignores it.

TextSourceDto.description:
A text or lower third (source kind SourceKind.Text). Scene items reference it by its `Id`, so
editing the text changes every scene that shows it. The renderer draws it as HTML text, never as a picture.

TextStyle.description: Fixed design of a text source; the colours come from the production's TextThemeDto.

TextThemeDto.description: Colours of all texts of a production (accent, background and text colour), each `#rrggbb`.

durationMs.description: Fade duration; one of 200, 300, 500, 800, 1000, 1500, 2000. Ignored (0) for a cut.

TransitionDto.description: Transition used for a program switch.

TransitionKind.description: Kind of transition between program scenes. A fade always runs to completion (no T-bar).

domain.description: Host name; optional in mode `internal`, required in the others.

acmeEmail.description: E-mail of the Let's Encrypt account (dns-* modes); optional.

dnsCredentials.description: The credentials of the provider; omitted: the stored ones stay.

UpdateAddressRequest.description: Sets the address and the certificate mode.

schedule.description: Cron expression of five fields; empty: off.

rcloneRemote.description: The rclone remote `name:path`; empty: no off-site copy.

rcloneConfig.description: The text of the rclone.conf; omitted: the stored one stays.

UpdateBackupRequest.description: Sets the backup schedule and the off-site target.

UpdateEmbeddingRequest.description: Sets the origins that may embed the output.

address.description: The IPv4 address LiveKit announces to the devices.

UpdateOutputAccessRequest.description: Sets the IP restriction of an output link.

UpdateProductionRequest.description: Partial update of a production. Null fields stay unchanged.

UpdateSceneRequest.description: Partial update of scene settings. Null fields stay unchanged.

UpdateTextSourceRequest.description: Replaces the content of a text source (last writer wins).

domain.description:
The host name the certificate must cover, when the address is about to change to it (the certificate comes first, the
address second); omitted: the saved domain, and no check of the name while there is none.

UploadCertificateRequest.description: Uploads the certificate and the private key of the mode `custom` (PEM text).
